title: Broke
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office faces financial difficulties as Michael Scott Paper Company is revealed to be broke. Tensions rise over negotiations with potential buyers and the company's value, while characters grapple with personal financial worries and office improvements. The episode culminates in Michael demanding his old job and parking space, asserting the company's dire financial state.
